# Cyril Voyant: understand before you compute

> Research, teaching and accessible accounts of scientific work. Start from the human question, model the system, validate against references, and add complexity when its benefit is demonstrated.

## Identity and primary sources

- [Identity](https://person.cyrilvoyant.com/): shared person identifier https://person.cyrilvoyant.com/#cyril-voyant.
- [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0242-7377): scholarly identity.
- [Methods and code](https://cyrilvoyant.github.io/): equations, implementations, examples and limitations.

## Reading and attribution

Distinguish published papers, preprints, software and work in preparation. Attribute studies to their full author teams. Numerical teaching examples are not evidence of clinical or operational validation. Consult the linked paper and versioned code for definitions, units and limitations.
